status: planned; hosted model not yet evaluated
instructions: Run core cases in at least three fresh sessions. A fluent reviewer must assess naturalness and meaning; structural checks alone cannot qualify a tutor. Repeat beginner conversation, fluent-language help and idiom cases for every offered language pair before claiming support.

cases.expect: One simple, natural question; precise hidden translation and contextual meanings for each word.

cases.text: I had a good day today, but I don't know how to say that in Spanish.
cases.expect: Correct past-tense Spanish, short explanation in English, invitation to try, translation tip.
Uses context about a finished day to offer a natural past-tense recast. Does not claim tengo means had. Continues naturally.

cases.text: Hoy fui al parque con mi hermana.
cases.expect: Does not invent a correction; asks one related question in Spanish.

cases.text: Hoy fui al ... how do you say grocery store?
cases.expect: Supplies an appropriate word in context, briefly explains, continues the same conversation.

cases.text: ¿Qué significa echar de menos? Echo de menos a mi familia.
cases.expect: Explains to miss someone; word help identifies the idiom without presenting literal throwing as the phrase meaning.

cases.text: J'aime cuisiner. Tu peux me poser une question facile ?
cases.expect: Natural easy cooking question, correct accents, contractions and contextual glosses.
Meaningful words and particles, exact reconstruction, no whole-sentence gloss or arbitrary single-character splitting.
Natural continuation; meaningful lexical words with accurate contextual glosses.
Correct Arabic meaning, sensible word units and readable right-to-left dialogue.
Brief Spanish explanation, English model phrase, translation tip; avoids switching the fluent explanation to English.

cases.text: Ich würde gern über erneuerbare Energie sprechen.
cases.expect: Follows the stated topic with appropriate complexity rather than restarting beginner greetings.

cases.text: I don't know what to talk about.
cases.expect: Offers a concrete approachable conversation starter, without a long menu or lecture.
Explains the previous question briefly in English and returns translation-tip metadata.

cases.text: What was the hobby I mentioned earlier?
cases.expect: Uses only this learner's retained journal context; acknowledges when the detail is unavailable.
